about: S4 slice 3: the tier-guard decision matrix of each former store-only Authority Role, recorded while it was still an assumable role (base 19b0a6a01). libs/core/testing/store-grant-equivalence.test.ts recomputes it under the store grant that replaced the role. Rows: per caller, per path, the verdicts of read|metadata|write|append|mkdir (A = allowed, D:<code> = denied, THROW:<code> = the role/grant could not be entered).
